items.q: How does the first meeting work?
items.a:
We begin with an introductory call to get to know each other, discuss your initial request and goals, and explore how we might work together. 
There is no obligation to continue — we can both decide whether it feels right to move forward.

Yes. Our introductory meeting takes place online, and most of the process is built around online sessions. 
If meeting in person becomes relevant, we can discuss the possibilities.

items.q: What are the session duration and fees?
items.a:
We discuss the session format, duration, and fees during our initial conversation and agree on a way forward that works for both of us.

I believe this work should be accessible to those who genuinely feel drawn to it. If your financial circumstances are a concern, please reach out anyway. We can discuss the possibilities and hopefully find a solution.

Absolutely. Your personal information and everything you share during our sessions remain confidential. No information about you or your personal journey is shared publicly. The sessions are never recorded.

items.q: What is the appropriate age for these sessions?
items.a: I currently work with individuals aged 14 and above. For anyone under 18, written parental consent is required, in accordance with the applicable requirements.

items.q: Can the sessions be helpful during career transitional periods?
items.a:
The sessions can certainly be helpful during such times — whether returning to sport after a break or injury, or navigating life after retirement. 
These moments often involve discovering a new way forward, and reconnecting with your intuition or deepening your self-reflection can help you find the path that is right for you.

items.q: What if I have never experienced intuition? Is it still possible to connect with it?
items.a:
We all connect with ourselves differently. Sometimes, what feels like an absence of intuition simply means that we haven't learned to recognise or trust its signals yet. There may also be something within us that feels reluctant to listen to what it has to say. Perhaps, you already receive its signals without necessarily calling them intuition. 

If you are curious and willing to explore, you will discover your own way of connecting with yourself.

items.q: I am not an athlete, but I feel I could benefit from these sessions. Can I reach out?
items.a:
Intuition and personal transformation are not exclusive to athletes — they are part of everyone's life.

For me, sport represents a kind of quintessence of life, where experiences, emotions and challenges can become particularly intense. This makes the role of intuition especially visible.

However, if you feel drawn to this work and are curious or motivated to explore it, please reach out. We can discuss your needs and whether working together would be a good fit.
